purpose: Where the 2026 election as the Electoral Commission ran it differs from IEC Circular 1 of 2025 Annexure A (March 2025). Applied on top of circular-1-2025-annexure-a.json by the candidate extractor and the national results build. Each correction names the Commission's own 2026 file that shows it.

corrections.why: Contested on its own with 9 wards and 17 seats. The Annexure's 7/13 was the split ahead of the proposed new FS164, which was not contested in 2026.
No results file and no seat calculation report for FS164 (both return 404), no FS164 rows in the 23 Oct 2026 certified candidate list, and FS162 was contested at its old size.
